hero.headline: Why do {dogName}'s ear infections keep coming back?
story: The first time your Frenchie shook their head like that, you thought it was minor. You went to the vet, got drops, and it improved. Three weeks later, it came back.

Then the guessing starts: the bath, the new food, the park, humidity, seasonal allergies, or just bad luck. You change drops, clean more often, and still the sour smell, red ear, and discomfort return.
The hard part is not caring for the ear. The hard part is treating the same fire again and again without knowing what keeps lighting it.

problem.title: The problem is not the infection.
problem.subtitle: The problem is that nobody is tracking the patterns.
problem.body: For Frenchies, ear episodes usually have a trigger: a protein they do not tolerate, moisture after a bath, pollen, heat, or an inconsistent cleaning routine. The pattern appears when you review organized weeks of data, not when you try to remember everything at the vet.
